name: k-Nearest-Neighbor Graph Construction
problem_statement: Construct a graph connecting each feature vector to its k nearest distinct input vectors under a declared distance metric.

normalization: Do not silently normalize vectors or change the requested distance.

problem_inputs.name: distance
problem_inputs.description: Metric used for search and returned edge weights.

problem_inputs.name: symmetrization
problem_inputs.description: Directed k-out graph, undirected union, or mutual-neighbor graph.

required_outputs.name: neighbor_lists
required_outputs.description: Exactly k unique non-self neighbors before symmetrization.

required_outputs.name: graph
required_outputs.description: Edges weighted by the declared distances.

required_outputs.name: search_metadata
required_outputs.description: Algorithm, exact/approximate mode, metric, seed and relevant index parameters.

solution_semantics.objective: Construct a graph connecting each feature vector to its k nearest distinct input vectors under a declared distance metric.
solution_semantics.exactness: Exact and approximate modes are separate and must be reported.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Each external vertex ID occurs once; output multiplicities follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No ordering among equally valid solutions is required.

validation_rules: Each vector has exactly dimension finite values and a unique ID.
No self-neighbors or duplicate neighbors; recompute distances independently.
Exact search must select k nearest neighbors; ties at the boundary can select any tied subset.
Approximate search reports recall@k against exact neighbors on a declared evaluation subset.
Symmetrization is applied after checking the directed neighbor lists.
edge_cases: Duplicate vectors with distinct IDs are valid zero-distance neighbors.
Reject zero-norm vectors for cosine distance.
An ANN navigation graph is not automatically a kNN result graph.

correctness: Each vector has exactly dimension finite values and a unique ID.
